vi.firstAction: Tiep tuc kiem tra dinh ky

zh.sub: 数据时间窗在健康范围内，当前可按标准流程继续执行。
zh.firstAction: 保持既有巡检节奏，记录本次 generatedAt。

en.sub: Data is within healthy time window and can follow normal operations.
en.firstAction: Keep normal patrol rhythm and log current generatedAt.

vi.sub: Du lieu nam trong cua so thoi gian an toan, co the tiep tuc van hanh chuan.
vi.firstAction: Giu nhip kiem tra thong thuong va ghi lai generatedAt hien tai.
Sap xep cua so chay lai

zh.sub: 数据接近时效上限，建议尽快刷新快照，避免进入 stale。
zh.firstAction: 先安排最近窗口重跑 check-family，并复核 ageMinutes。

en.sub: Data is approaching max age and should be refreshed soon to avoid stale.
en.firstAction: Schedule the nearest check-family rerun and verify ageMinutes again.

vi.sub: Du lieu dang gan nguong toi da, can lam moi som de tranh stale.
vi.firstAction: Sap xep chay lai check-family som nhat va kiem tra lai ageMinutes.

vi.sub: Lam moi truoc khi danh gia

zh.sub: 当前快照已陈旧或时间戳异常，结论可信度下降。
zh.firstAction: 先重跑 check-family 生成新快照，再继续发布相关判读。

en.sub: Snapshot is stale or timestamp is abnormal, so confidence is reduced.
en.firstAction: Rerun check-family first to generate a fresh snapshot before release interpretation.

vi.sub: Snapshot da cu hoac timestamp bat thuong, do tin cay giam.
vi.firstAction: Chay lai check-family truoc de tao snapshot moi, roi moi dien giai quyet dinh phat hanh.

staleClarification.zh: stale 表示数据时效过期，不等于系统故障；请先重跑 check-family 再判断系统状态。
staleClarification.en: Stale means data freshness expired, not necessarily a system fault; rerun check-family before judging system health.
staleClarification.vi: Stale co nghia la du lieu het do tuoi, khong dong nghia loi he thong; hay chay lai check-family truoc khi ket luan.
